concept: Systems Manager Patch Manager: patching an EC2 fleet
tests: Choosing a service for scheduled OS patching across many EC2 instances with compliance reporting, without logging into servers.
expected: SSM Patch Manager: patch baselines, maintenance windows, patch compliance reports. Triggers: "apply OS patches on a schedule", "track compliance", "avoid logging into each server".
why_not: Inspector finds vulnerabilities but does not patch; Config tracks state; CloudFormation provisions.
